This disposable fixture explicitly requests native subagents. Launch two native workers together and observe the default checkout they actually edit. Instruct A to run pwd first without cd or a workdir override, then write exactly alpha plus newline to the relative file probe.txt with its default editing tool, intended checkout ../a. Instruct B likewise with bravo plus newline, intended checkout ../b. Both must use the ordinary unqualified relative edit, even if the default pwd is the disposable integration checkout. All three checkouts are disposable test data. No git commits. Wait for both and report their observed shell and edit targets, including any collision. No elevated permissions or reads of credentials.
